scope: Plugin runtime termination, pre-store signature admission and failure recovery. Installed recovery, isolated admission probes and focused native execution are distinct evidence.

installedRecovery.condition: Installed cache lacked the signed TypeScript discovery symlink. SIGTERM entered nested AppKit termination from a main-actor task and blocked its saved shutdown task.
installedRecovery.mechanism: Cancel only the nested quit; detach debugger; allow the original lifecycle task to finish saving and close IPC; issue a second ordinary quit.
installedRecovery.scope: Recovery of the old incomplete installed runtime; does not verify installation or admission of candidate 252.

isolatedAppKit.result: Task-entered terminateLater stalls; run-loop entry completes. Cancel-quit then saved-drain then ordinary quit exits normally.

regression.scope: Actual NotebookRuntime.swift with a data-free lifecycle fixture and admission stub; real AppKit event loops. No installed runtime or user data.

signedAdmission.scope: Actual Release entrypoint and signature owner in signed tiny apps; invalid sealed resources fail before lifecycle construction. Explicit signed acceptance remains admitted.

finalNativeRun.scope: Signed macOS XCTest host: read/publication Retry, accepted ink across refused shutdown and Retry, real sandboxed TypeScript compilation and refusal before native effects. No physical iPad or visible Codex panel.

remaining: Installed Codex panel and physical iPad acceptance

independentReview.scope: Final diff, current inventory, before/after source receipts, executed selectors, artifact hashes and signed admission source hashes; no additional test run.
